words: At D1 after a rewarded rare a1->S2 trial: high before trial 70, low after; medium after a rewarded a2->S2 trial that followed an a1 choice.
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is('a1 S2 r') * (ep_trial < 70) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is('a1 S2 r') * (ep_trial >= 70) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is('a2 S2 r') * (tv('action', -2) == 1)

firing_record.label: D1 reward shown after reaching S2 (strongest after rare a1->S2 reward), fades late in episode

magnitude_record.label: At D1, fires after rewarded rare a1->S2 trials (fading late in episode); weaker after rewarded a2->S2 following an a1 choice.
